Detailed Working:

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420489-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P9 312561850/14] Charging Session CRM:02679000148
additional_info.body:
Dear Florent,
I hope all is well with you. Please be aware that the power converter [2102312VGQKXMA000229] behaved abnormally after the E17 error flag and is unable to build the battery voltage after error flags become false. This led to the abnormal power drop from the charger side. Please note that R&D is already working on this bug fix, and FW v9.0.x will contain the bug fix for the issue. I have checked the converter performance for 3 months, and the error occurrence is very low, so there is no need to replace the affected converter.  Thank you very much for being understanding and patient.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
